title: Once-reinforced random walk in high dimensions
summary: We study the once-reinforced random walk on $\mathbb Z^d$, which is a self-interacting walk that has a higher probability to cross edges that were already visited. We prove that the walk is transient when $d\ge 6$ and when the reinforcement is small, establishing a conjecture of Sidoravicius in these dimensions. Moreover, in this case we prove that the walk behaves diffusively and can be coupled with Brownian motion.
